video_title: "I got Jazz across my chest now" | Darryn Peterson on his debut, playing in front of Jazz fans

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on the atmosphere of playing for Jazz fans
quotes.excerpt: When I put on the uniform it's not just for myself, it's for the fans as well.
quotes.quote: It was great. It reminds me of Kansas a little bit with a great fan base. Like I said in the media before, when I put on the uniform it's not just for myself, it's for the fans as well. Happy to see me out there.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on his first game since March
quotes.excerpt: That was my first game since my last game in March.
quotes.quote: That was my first game since my last game in March. And that was also on my mind because Zuby's was on the other team and they beat us on that game winner. I don't know if you guys seen it, but that was on my mind. So happy to get the win.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on the honor of playing for the Jazz
quotes.excerpt: I got Jazz across my chest now, so it's a huge honor and privilege.
quotes.quote: I've been training super hard, manifesting this game since the season ended. To be out there and finally be able to put on a jersey and play against great, and then on top of that, I got Jazz across my chest now, so it's a huge honor and privilege.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on Keyonte George's mentorship
quotes.excerpt: Leaning on guys like Keyonte, he's been at every practice and been pushing me to do certain things.
quotes.quote: Leaning on guys like Keyonte, he's been at every practice and been pushing me to do certain things and holding me accountable. I can't wait to play with him, play together.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on building chemistry with veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: Only one that's been coaching me up is Keyonte on court.
quotes.quote: Those guys were at the scrimmage we had the other day. We spent some time together at coach's house and we'll probably get together today for the fourth. Just been like welcome and happy to have me. Only one that's been coaching me up is Keyonte on court.
